records.label: human
records.text:
Vikram Jain
Data Analyst

I have worked mostly with Go, plus Kafka 3.6 when the project called for it.
At Riverline Tech, I moved a nightly import into smaller jobs; it used to take about three hours and now usually finishes in 39 minutes.
Fixed the duplicate retry path after it affected 39 customer records. That one needed a data repair script and a slightly awkward Monday call.
On a team of 4, I reviewed changes and looked after Redis 7.
The first version was rough and we rewrote the retry part after an outage.
Side project: a bus reminder bot for my family. It runs on an old mini PC.
